name: Outbreak READY!
description: Free online epidemic response simulation for NGO and humanitarian organization leaders. Players make decisions about outbreak response in resource-limited humanitarian settings, navigating information uncertainty, coordination challenges, and trade-offs between competing priorities. Joint development by Johns Hopkins Bloomberg School of Public Health and Save the Children.
domain: epidemic response, humanitarian health, NGO crisis management
general_score_metric: composite scenario outcome score (scenario-based performance / decision quality)
reputation: well-regarded free training resource used by humanitarian organizations worldwide
notes: Free online simulation. Covers Ebola-like outbreak scenarios in humanitarian settings. Decision tree format with branching outcomes. Available in multiple languages.

institutions: Johns Hopkins Bloomberg School of Public Health
